question: How many worlds are counted in the tanmātra, sense, mind, and ego domains together?
premises: Ten worlds are placed in the tanmātra group.
More worlds are placed in the sense group and in mind and ego.
The verse gives a total of twenty-two worlds.
inference: Across the tanmātra, sense, mind, and ego domains, the compendium counts twenty-two worlds in all.
uncertainties: The internal subdivision of the twenty-two is not fully itemized in this verse.
plain_english: There are ten worlds in the tanmātra group, and others in the sense group and in mind and ego; altogether there are twenty-two worlds.
